Even every activity hour, days keep type, match depend remembering day exactly.
code: survey_days <- atus_days |>   select(id, weight, day_type, all_of(activity_categories$category)) |>   pivot_longer(all_of(activity_categories$category),                names_to = "category", values_to = "you")  closest_type <- function(days) {   days |>     left_join(day_type_profiles, by = "category",               relationship = "many-to-many",               suffix = c("", "_matched")) |>     group_by(id, weight, day_type, day_type_matched) |>     summarise(hours_apart = sum(abs(you - minutes)) / 2 / 60,               .groups = "drop") |>     group_by(id) |>     slice_min(hours_apart, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>     ungroup() }  matched <- closest_type(survey_days)  matched |>   summarise(percent_same_type = round(     weighted.mean(day_type == day_type_matched, weight) * 100   )) #> # A tibble: 1 × 1 #>   percent_same_type #>               <dbl> #> 1                93 set.seed(5523)  keeps_type <- function(minutes_off) {   noisy_days <- survey_days |>     group_by(id) |>     mutate(       noisy = pmax(you + rnorm(n(), 0, minutes_off), 0),       you = noisy * sum(you) / sum(noisy)     ) |>     ungroup() |>     select(-noisy)    closest_type(noisy_days) |>     left_join(select(matched, id, original = day_type_matched), by = "id") |>     summarise(percent_same_type = round(       weighted.mean(day_type_matched == original, weight) * 100     )) }  keeps_type(30) #> # A tibble: 1 × 1 #>   percent_same_type #>               <dbl> #> 1                91 keeps_type(60) #> # A tibble: 1 × 1 #>   percent_same_type #>               <dbl> #> 1                83
